info.name: SAP S/4HANA Sales Order API
Sales Orders
Sap S/4hana Retrieve a List of Sales Orders

params.name: $top
params.description: Maximum number of entities to return

params.name: $skip
params.description: Number of entities to skip

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to include in the response

params.name: $expand
params.description: Comma-separated list of navigation properties to expand

params.name: $orderby
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties for sorting (e.g., 'CreationDate desc')

params.name: $inlinecount
params.description: Include total count of matching entities

items.docs: Returns a collection of sales order header records. Supports OData system query options including $filter, $select, $expand, $orderby, $top, $skip, and $inlinecount for pagination. Use $expand to include related entities such as items, partners, and pricing elements in the response.

info.name: Sap S/4hana Create a New Sales Order

items.docs: Creates a new sales order in SAP S/4HANA. Supports deep insert, allowing you to create a header along with items, partners, pricing elements, schedule lines, billing plans, and text records in a single request. The SalesOrderType, SalesOrganization, DistributionChannel, and OrganizationDivision are required for creation.

info.name: Sap S/4hana Retrieve a Single Sales Order by Key

params.name: SalesOrder
params.description: Sales order number (10-character string, e.g., '0000000001')

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to include in the response

params.name: $expand
params.description: Comma-separated list of navigation properties to expand

items.docs: Returns a single sales order header record identified by its sales order number. Use $expand to include related entities such as to_Item, to_Partner, and to_PricingElement.

info.name: Sap S/4hana Update a Sales Order Header

params.name: SalesOrder
params.description: Sales order number (10-character string, e.g., '0000000001')

items.docs: Performs a partial update (MERGE/PATCH) on an existing sales order header. Only the fields provided in the request body are updated. Requires an If-Match header with the entity ETag for optimistic concurrency control.

info.name: Sap S/4hana Delete a Sales Order

params.name: SalesOrder
params.description: Sales order number (10-character string, e.g., '0000000001')

items.docs: Deletes an existing sales order. Requires an If-Match header with the entity ETag for optimistic concurrency control. A sales order can only be deleted if its processing status permits deletion.

info.name: Sap S/4hana Create a New Sales Order Item

params.name: SalesOrder
params.description: Sales order number (10-character string, e.g., '0000000001')

items.docs: Creates a new line item within an existing sales order. The Material field is typically required. Supports deep insert for creating pricing elements, schedule lines, partners, and text along with the item.
